summary: Requested one more revision of the shutdown probe to test the mechanism rather than the symptom. The corrected Fact attributes the strand to a buffered channel whose send stays selectable after the run loop exits, with Barrier and Apply escaping only because applyCh is unbuffered by default — and Config.BatchApplyCh exists precisely to buffer applyCh, with its own comment warning that it breaks the timeout guarantee on Apply. The harness now records batch_apply_ch and adds three batched trials each for Barrier and Apply beside the default and control cases, with five comparisons separating the batched cases from the unbuffered ones and re-measuring the VerifyLeader strand in the same run. A construction run showed the expected flip — with BatchApplyCh, Barrier answered 5, 5 and 3 of 8 post-shutdown calls and Apply 5, 3 and 5, versus 8 of 8 for both in every unbuffered trial — but no observation is claimed until the clean-copy receipt exists. Unfinished: interpreting that receipt and folding the causal contrast into the account.
